author: John T. Morse Jr.
claims: Abraham Lincoln was to be the next president of the United States in the autumn of 1860.
Following his election in 1860, Lincoln was immediately approached by office seekers and individuals who warned him of assassination threats.
The news of Lincoln's election in 1860 arrived throughout the day, leading to a celebratory atmosphere.
Lincoln's election was secured by successes achieved by the Republican party.
The Republican party nominated Lincoln for the presidency in 1860.
The Republican party's moral attitude toward slavery was the real cause of secession.
The Republican party's legal position on slavery was a factor in the events.
The Republican party elected Lincoln.
The Republican party's leaders initially distrusted Lincoln.
The Republican party was dissatisfied with Lincoln's cabinet.
The Republican party was dissatisfied with Lincoln's emancipation policy.
The Republican party was torn by factions.
Abolitionist members of the Republican party denounced Lincoln.
Leaders of the Republican party condemned Lincoln.
A majority of the Republican party continued to support Lincoln.
Greeley influenced the Republican party.
The Republican party upheld the Emancipation Proclamation.
The Republican party lost in the congressional elections of 1862.
The radical wing of the Republican party demanded the dismissal of Seward.
The Republican party regained ground in 1863.
An extreme faction of the Republican party still distrusted Lincoln and Seward.
Members of the Republican party denounced Lincoln for vetoing a reconstruction bill.
There was a movement within the Republican party to nominate Chase.
There was a movement within the Republican party to nominate Fremont.
The masses of the Republican party adhered to Lincoln.
The Republican party failed to postpone its nominating convention.
The Republican party nominated Johnson for Vice President.
The Republican party received the reluctant support of radicals.
The Republican party was damaged by Greeley's denunciations of Lincoln.
The Republican party dreaded defeat in the summer of 1864.
The Republican party was damaged by the draft.
The radical element of the Republican party forced the dismissal of Blair.
The Republican party conducted its campaign.
The Republican party gained the election in 1864.
The Republican party made the Thirteenth Amendment a plank in its platform.
Radical members of the Republican party rejoiced at the accession of Johnson after the murder of Lincoln.
